claim: Tesla's 2023 Q2 period guidance calls for $27.4 billion of revenue.
summary: From own knowledge without tools, there is no established record that Tesla issued 2023 Q2 revenue guidance calling for $27.4 billion. Tesla typically does not provide quarterly revenue guidance, and the asserted figure is not verified.

sub_claims.text: Tesla issued revenue guidance for the 2023 Q2 period.
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge alone with no tools, there is no established record of Tesla issuing quarterly revenue guidance for Q2 2023; Tesla typically does not issue quarterly revenue guidance.

sub_claims.text: Tesla's 2023 Q2 guidance amount was $27.4 billion of revenue.
sub_claims.note: No knowledge establishes a $27.4 billion guided revenue figure for Tesla Q2 2023.
